lena: Who's bringing what to the Final Four potluck/watch? I'm doing wings and a ridiculous playlist. :headphones: :chicken:

omar: I'll handle chips + guac. Also bringing my lucky foam finger. Yes it's a thing. :v:

rex: Can someone set up the laptop stream? My dongle is ancient. `DisplayPort->HDMI`

 lena: Can somebody volunteer to manage the scoreboard? I can tally live fantasy points if someone posts box score screenshots.

 omar: I'll do scoreboard duty. Also side-bet: if someone nails a half-time hat trick prediction, winner picks next week's snack order.

 cecilia: Count me in for snack chooser if the hat trick happens. :pretzel:

 lena: See y'all at 18:30. May your waiver claims process in peace. :pray:

 ben: I'll take +7.5 and a bag of buffalo ranch.

 meme-bot: :guardsman: Betting window closes at tip-off. Play nice and hydrate.
